title: calomyrtus excelsa
intro: Calomyrtus excelsa, commonly known as the 'Mountain Calamint', is a perennial plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Calomyrtus excelsa include calming and soothing effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as citral, geraniol, and limonene, among others. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it a valuable herbal remedy for various health conditions.
